title: Field boundaries for Czech
description: Official field boundary dataset for the Czech Republic containing 426,584 agricultural parcels sourced from the Czech Ministry of Agriculture (Ministr Zemědělství) LPIS system. Each record includes crop code, crop name, field area, and determination date. Released under the EU INSPIRE directive and converted to fiboa GeoParquet format.

## README.md
# Field boundaries for Czech

Provides 426584 official field boundaries from Czech.
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from data obtained from Czech Ministry of Agriculture (Ministr Zemědělství).

- **Source Data Provider:** [Czech Ministry of Agriculture (Ministr Zemědělství)](https://mze.gov.cz/public/portal/mze/farmar/LPIS)
- **Converted by:** Ivor Bosloper
- **License:** CC-0 (Publicly distributed as part of the Inspire directive)
- **Projection:** EPSG:5514 or EPSG:4258

---

- [Download the data as fiboa GeoParquet](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/czech/czech.parquet)
- [STAC Browser](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/data.source.coop/fiboa/czech/stac/collection.json)
- [STAC Collection](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/czech/stac/collection.json)
- [PMTiles](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/czech/czech.pmtiles)

## Columns

| Property               | **Data Type** | Description |
|------------------------|---------------|-------------|
| id                     | string        |             |
| block_id               | string        |             |
| crop_code              | string        |             |
| crop_name              | string        |             |
| area                   | float         |             |
| determination_datetime | timestamp     |             |

## Lineage

- Data downloaded on 2024-11-15 from https://mze.gov.cz/public/app/eagriapp/Files/geoprostor_zadosti23_2024-08-01_202409261243_epsg4258.zip.
- Converted to GeoParquet using [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli), version 0.8.0
